steps.name: gcr.io/cloud-builders/docker@sha256:fbc05705e6f24467e40ae8a4097ab9b8fae1116551f838fa2c55f4367427fc36
args:
import os,json,stat,sys
from pathlib import Path
assert os.getuid()==10001 and os.getgid()==10001
for name in ('context_operator.py','context-operator-manifest.json'):
 p=Path('/opt/ocean')/name;s=p.stat();assert s.st_uid==0 and stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)==0o444
assert not any(os.environ.get(k) for k in ('DATABASE_URL','OCEAN_V1_OPERATOR_DATABASE_URL','OCEAN_V1_DATABASE_URL','GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS'))
import context_operator as c
m=json.loads(Path('/opt/ocean/context-operator-manifest.json').read_bytes())
assert m['revision']=='1d20cf2f8ae625b1fdcf79a3be896a16c5d1560b'
base=c.load_base_operator()
env={'DEPLOYMENT_ENV':'production','OCEAN_V1_PROJECT_ID':c.PROJECT,'OCEAN_V1_SQL_CONNECTION_NAME':c.CONNECTION,'OCEAN_V1_CONTEXT_OPERATOR_REVISION':m['revision'],'OCEAN_V1_OPERATOR_DATABASE_URL':'postgresql+psycopg2://ocean_v1_migrator:offline-placeholder@127.0.0.1:5432/ocean_v1_beta'}
s=c.configuration(env,confirm_project=c.PROJECT,confirm_database=c.DATABASE,confirm_source=m['revision'],confirm_operator=c.BASE_OPERATOR_REVISION)
assert s.revision==m['revision'] and 'config' not in sys.modules and 'api.main' not in sys.modules
print(json.dumps({'state':'context_operator_image_source_verified','revision':s.revision,'uid':os.getuid(),'base_operator_source_verified':True,'root_owned_0444':True,'synthetic_configuration_only':True,'database_or_secrets_accessed':False,'network':'none'}))
